summary: Mendocino County enclosed lookout on Mathison Peak; a 30-foot tower was reported going up in 1934 and staffed into 1956; FFLOS list marks it gone, no date.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry (per page heading)
facts.design: enclosed tower (FFLOS list type); a 30-foot tower was under construction in 1934
facts.status_note: FFLOS California list marks the site Gone, with no date

staffing.status: Frank Mathison named in charge in 1934 and reported as the lookout in 1935; Emma Mathison in charge in 1949; a 1956 entry adds a Ground Observer Corps Skywatch role

events.note: Ukiah newspaper notices of August 1934 describe a 30-foot tower being erected on the Mathison place

notes_for_editor: The 1934 to 1956 facts come from newspaper notices and recollections as transcribed on a hobby site (source 1), not from the original papers. The 1927 Mattson notice may or may not refer to this site; the story says so. Agency comes only from the page heading. Both essays (sources 2 and 3) are personal recollections by one writer. No source describes the site today. The 30-foot figure is taken as the tower height and converted to metres (9.1). The Calisphere photo record for a Mathison Peak lookout tower platform could not be read from cache, so no photo was added.
